# Video V-03: Check the invoices the day's orders produced

## Script

Say: "This is how the bookkeeper does this, at the end of each day." [SC-12]

1. Show and say: "Open QuickBooks Online at the end of the day." [SC-12 step 1]
2. Show and say: "Check the day's invoices against the confirmed orders." [SC-12 step 2]
